links.outcome: Patient trust in ML-based clinical decision support after receiving information on the technology versus controls
links.effect: Intervention increased trust vs active control (5% [1%;9%], p=0.009) and vs blank control (4% [1%;8%], p=0.015); distrust decreased by 3-4%. Small effect size.
links.quote: The intervention increased trust in ML-based clinical decision support systems when compared to the active control (mean absolute difference in trust: 5% [95%CI: 1%;9%], p-value= 0·009) and the blank control arm (mean absolute difference in trust: 4% [1%;8%], p-value=0·015).
